purpose: capture one current official Polymarket documentation index and identify genuinely new market-direction-independent reward fee settlement conversion or execution mechanisms before any market-data request

source.endpoint_classification: public unauthenticated static official documentation index; not an account market order or state-changing endpoint

offline_classification.candidate_boundary: an official current page must describe a distinct economic cash flow cost reduction settlement right or executable package absent from mechanism aliases and canonical sources in the structural registry
offline_classification.duplicate_boundary: a renamed page product surface or implementation guide for an existing payoff identity updates that family only and cannot create a new hypothesis
offline_classification.promotion_boundary: none; a novel page may only nominate a separately frozen source and economic gate

stop_rules: do not request any linked page until the complete retained index is deduplicated against the registry
do not request market data books fees accounts or orders in this stage
do not adapt terms after viewing the index
do not infer a cash flow from an SDK API or integration page title
preserve any HTTP or parse failure and do not rerun this contract
